topic.title: The Indus script nobody can read
topic.angle: The Indus (Harappan) civilisation flourished around 2600-1900 BCE in what is now Pakistan and north-west India
key_facts: The Indus (Harappan) civilisation flourished around 2600-1900 BCE in what is now Pakistan and north-west India
Thousands of inscribed seals and objects survive, but the script has never been deciphered
Inscriptions are very short, typically around five signs, with roughly 400 distinct signs
There is no known bilingual text, unlike the Rosetta Stone, which is a major reason it resists decipherment
In January 2025 Tamil Nadu's chief minister announced a US$1 million prize for anyone who deciphers it

opening.why: The seal with its unreadable signs is the hook; the region is well known to Indian viewers.

headline: INDIA'S CODE
NO ONE CAN READ
hook_voiceover: 4,000 വർഷം പഴയ ഒരു ഇന്ത്യൻ ലിപി. ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരാൾക്കും അത് വായിക്കാനാവില്ല!
cover_visual: A small square clay seal fills the frame: a carved unicorn-like bull and a row of strange signs above it, lit from the side.

scenes.voiceover: മോഹൻജൊദാരോയും ഹാരപ്പയും. 4,000 വർഷം മുമ്പത്തെ വമ്പൻ നഗരങ്ങൾ.
scenes.caption: CITIES 4,000 YEARS AGO
scenes.visual: A top-down plan of a brick city grows: straight streets, blocks, and a large bath; tiny dots of people move along the streets.

scenes.voiceover: അവിടെ നിന്ന് ആയിരക്കണക്കിന് മുദ്രകൾ കിട്ടി. എല്ലാത്തിലും ഒരേ തരം അടയാളങ്ങൾ.
scenes.caption: THOUSANDS OF SEALS
scenes.visual: A grid of small seals fills the screen one by one, each with a different animal and a few signs; the camera drifts over them.

scenes.voiceover: പക്ഷേ ഓരോ എഴുത്തിലും ശരാശരി അഞ്ച് അടയാളം മാത്രം. പരിഭാഷയുള്ള ഒരു കല്ലും കിട്ടിയിട്ടില്ല.
scenes.caption: NO ROSETTA STONE
scenes.visual: Left: a short row of five signs with a question mark pulse; right: a stone slab with three text bands where two are unreadable and one is blank where a translation should be.

scenes.voiceover: ദ്രാവിഡമോ? സംസ്കൃതത്തിന്റെ പൂർവികനോ? AI പോലും തോറ്റു.
scenes.caption: EVERY THEORY FAILED
scenes.visual: Signs float in the air while glowing 'keys' (theory shapes) try to fit a lock and bounce off; a computer screen of scrolling symbols flickers behind.

scenes.voiceover: 2025-ൽ തമിഴ്നാട് ഒരു മില്യൺ ഡോളർ സമ്മാനം പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു. 4,000 വർഷത്തെ ഈ നിശ്ശബ്ദത ആര് പൊളിക്കും?
scenes.caption: $1 MILLION PRIZE
scenes.visual: A spotlight on the seal from the cover; a glowing prize ring and coins orbit it; the signs stay unlit, waiting.

instagram_caption:
A 4,000-year-old Indian script that nobody has ever been able to read. 🔍

The Indus cities of Mohenjo-daro and Harappa left thousands of seals with short inscriptions, about five signs each, and no bilingual text to help. Every theory, from Dravidian to 'not a language at all', has failed. In 2025 Tamil Nadu announced a $1 million prize for anyone who cracks it. 💰

Could it be a language we still speak today? 👀
